description: Product analytics: users, engagement, acquisition, feature adoption, and retention.
title: Forge Business

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "val" FROM forge_signals_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END

SELECT count(*) AS "val" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END

SELECT coalesce(avg(duration_secs), 0)::int AS "val" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND duration_secs IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END

SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_bounce) / count(*))::numeric(5,1) END AS "val" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END

SELECT coalesce(avg(page_view_count), 0)::numeric(10,1) AS "val" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END

SELECT CASE WHEN mau = 0 THEN 0 ELSE dau::float / mau END AS "val" FROM (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE) AS dau, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS mau FROM forge_signals_events WHERE timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END) t

SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS time, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "users" FROM forge_signals_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS time, count(*) AS "sessions" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS time, avg(duration_secs)::int AS "avg duration" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND duration_secs IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT function_name AS "Feature", count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Users", count(*) AS "Calls" FROM forge_signals_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND event_type = 'rpc_call' AND function_name IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY function_name ORDER BY "Users" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT event_name AS "Event", count(*) AS "Count", count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Users", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "Sessions" FROM forge_signals_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND event_type = 'track' AND event_name IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY "Count" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT coalesce(referrer_domain, 'Direct') AS "Source", count(*) AS "Sessions" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY referrer_domain ORDER BY "Sessions" DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT coalesce(utm_source, '(organic)') AS "Source", coalesce(utm_medium, '-') AS "Medium", coalesce(utm_campaign, '-') AS "Campaign", count(*) AS "Sessions", count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS "Visitors", (100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_bounce) / GREATEST(count(*), 1))::numeric(5,1) AS "Bounce %" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign ORDER BY "Sessions" DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT 'New' AS metric, count(*) AS "val" FROM forge_signals_users WHERE first_seen_at >= $__timeFrom() AND last_seen_at >= $__timeFrom() UNION ALL SELECT 'Returning' AS metric, count(*) AS "val" FROM forge_signals_users WHERE first_seen_at < $__timeFrom() AND last_seen_at >= $__timeFrom()

WITH cohorts AS (SELECT id AS uid, date_trunc('week', first_seen_at)::date AS cohort FROM forge_signals_users), activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, date_trunc('week', timestamp)::date AS week FROM forge_signals_events WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '8 weeks') SELECT c.cohort::text AS "Cohort", count(DISTINCT c.uid) AS "Size", count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week = c.cohort) AS "W0", count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week = c.cohort + 7) AS "W1", count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week = c.cohort + 14) AS "W2", count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week = c.cohort + 21) AS "W3" FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN activity a ON c.uid = a.user_id GROUP BY c.cohort ORDER BY c.cohort DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT entry_page AS "Page", count(*) AS "Sessions", (100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_bounce) / GREATEST(count(*), 1))::numeric(5,1) AS "Bounce %", coalesce(avg(duration_secs), 0)::int AS "Avg Duration (s)" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND entry_page IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY entry_page ORDER BY "Sessions" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT entry_page AS "Entry", exit_page AS "Exit", count(*) AS "Sessions", avg(page_view_count)::numeric(10,1) AS "Avg Pages", avg(duration_secs)::int AS "Avg Duration (s)" FROM forge_signals_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND entry_page IS NOT NULL AND exit_page IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_bounce AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY entry_page, exit_page ORDER BY "Sessions" DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT country AS "Country", count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Users", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "Sessions", count(*) AS "Events" FROM forge_signals_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND country IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY country ORDER BY "Users" DESC

SELECT country AS "Country", count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Users", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "Sessions", count(*) AS "Events", (100.0 * count(DISTINCT user_id)::float / GREATEST((SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM forge_signals_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL), 1))::numeric(5,1) AS "% Users" FROM forge_signals_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND country IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'humans' THEN is_bot = FALSE WHEN '${bot_filter}' = 'bots' THEN is_bot = TRUE ELSE TRUE END GROUP BY country ORDER BY "Users" DESC LIMIT 15
